introduction: The Pacman Nebula combines high-energy X-rays with infrared observations of the same region.
observe: Isolate the purple structures from the red, green and blue field.
Look for places where X-ray and infrared features coincide.
explanation: The source combines Chandra X-ray data with Spitzer infrared observations of the star cluster and nebula.
colorMethod: X-rays are mapped to purple; Spitzer infrared observations are mapped across red, green and blue.
whyItMatters: A composite can compare different energy regimes without forcing them into separate images.
